text: dsh-html-inspector 是供 DSH Web 客户端使用的 HTML 页面选区插件。它为本机网页提供注入检查脚本的代理路由，并在文件树 HTML 预览中注入同类脚本；用户悬停可高亮元素，点击后将 CSS 选择器、文本和 HTML 片段写入当前会话输入框。地址栏本机 URL 会改走代理，工具栏可切换选区模式，Escape 可取消。适合根据本地演示页面元素向 agent 描述修改目标；不需要额外配置。

dsh-html-inspector lets DSH web users select elements in local pages and previews. Hover to highlight; click to add the selector, text, and HTML to chat. A toolbar toggle controls selection mode; Escape cancels. It helps users point an agent to a demo element.
我想点一下本地网页里的控件，让 DSH 知道我想改哪一块。
怎么把 HTML 预览中选中的元素定位信息放进对话框？
让 DSH 能把我点到的页面元素转成 CSS 选择器和 HTML 片段。
dsh-html-inspector 的功能「点击定位页面元素」：开启选区模式后，悬停会高亮元素，点击会捕获 CSS 选择器、可见文本和 HTML 片段，并将其加入当前会话输入框。
dsh-html-inspector 的功能「本机页面代理」：地址栏输入 loopback HTTP 页面时，插件通过 /inspector/proxy 注入检查脚本，让点选可用。
dsh-html-inspector 会通过 DSH 本机代理读取用户指定的 loopback HTTP 页面，并把选区内容放入会话输入；实现中未配置外部服务或 API 密钥。

dsh-html-inspector README · dsh-html-inspector：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`): turn it on, click any element in a locally served demo page, and the element's locator — CSS selector, visible text, and an HTML snippet — is written straight into the chat input, so the agent can edit precisely what you pointed at. Nothing on disk is ever modified.

dsh-html-inspector README · What you get：- **Click-to-locate** — hover highlights the element under the cursor with a blue outline; click captures tag, id, classes, a `nth-of-type` CSS selector path, up to 1200 chars of visible text, and up to 4000 chars of the element's outer HTML, then writes it into the current conversation's input box. `Esc` cancels.
- **Browser tab support** — type a loopback address (`localhost` / `127.0.0.1`) into a dsh browser tab and the plugin transparently routes it through an injecting proxy (`/inspector/proxy`); selections survive navigation.
- **File preview support** — HTML files opened from the file tree (`/sidebar/html` editor iframe) get the same treatment: the preview frame is swapped for a same-content copy with the inspector injected (`<base>` preserved for relative assets), and selections are tagged with a "file preview" origin marker.
- **Selection mode toolbar button** — injects an on/off toggle into the browser-tab toolbar of `dsh-better-sidebar` when present (optional; everything else works without it). The choice is remembered per tab session; it defaults to on.

dsh-html-inspector README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:robin421/dsh-html-inspector
```

Or one click from [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market#readme) (Settings → Plugin Market) once listed.

Restart the web GUI (or refresh the page), then look for the **selection mode** button in the browser-tab toolbar, or just type a `localhost` URL into a browser tab.

dsh-html-inspector README · How it works：- **Host side** (`index.js`) — a cordis plugin that registers one route, `GET /inspector/proxy?url=…`. It fetches the loopback URL, rewrites same-origin links so navigation stays inside the proxy, and injects a self-contained inspector script. No dependencies beyond the dsh runtime.
- **Client side** (`client.js`) — loaded via the dsh client runtime (`dsh.client`, platform `web`). It intercepts loopback address-bar input, listens for `postMessage` selections from proxied pages, writes located info into the chat composer, and manages the toolbar toggle.
- The two halves never talk to the network beyond your own machine.

dsh-html-inspector README · Compatibility：- Works with the web GUI and desktop clients that ship the dsh client runtime.
- The toolbar button appears only if `dsh-better-sidebar` is installed; the address-bar interception and file-preview selection mode work regardless.

dsh-html-inspector README · Security：The proxy binds to loopback targets only (exact-match `localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `::1`, `0.0.0.0`) and rejects everything else. It performs GET fetches of pages you ask it to proxy, injects the inspector script, and returns the result to your own GUI. It stores nothing and sends nothing anywhere.
